displayName: Depop API - Listings, Shop Sold Prices, Seller Reviews
description: Depop API for Depop resale prices - search Depop listings in any of its 9 storefronts (US, UK, Australia, Ireland, Canada, New Zealand, Germany, France, Italy) priced for a buyer in that market (listing price, original price, buyer fee, tax, shipping and total as Depop shows them), browse a category, a brand or a curated explore page, read one listing in full with the seller's rating, reviews and items sold, and read a shop's profile, its listings for sale, its sold listings with the price they sold at and the reviews it received. Plus the category tree, brand list, search suggestions and similar listings. Search, category, brand and explore return the first 24 results per query (Depop serves no next page). 14 endpoints, 1 credit per call (product 2 outside the US; New Zealand 5, product 6). No keyword sold search (sold prices come per shop), no sale dates, no price history (poll and store).

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
